cases.note: The observer has one Allow rule per value and a catch-all; a known property also matches its value rule, while an unknown one matches none (§applicability), so only the catch-all applies to it.

cases.name: read-elevation-reads-scope-field-not-property
cases.note: Chocolatey's scope is Machine when Scope is absent (§manager-chocolatey), and Elevation is NonElevated, so the request is unreadable (§reading). Control: read-chocolatey-scope-default-machine, which is Elevated.

cases.name: read-elevation-ignores-scope-parameter
cases.note: '--scope machine' sets the scope to Machine without Scope, and Elevation is NonElevated, so the request is unreadable (§reading). Control: read-winget-scope-machine, which is Elevated.

cases.name: read-elevation-known-when-scope-unknown
cases.note: The scope is set twice and unknown (§reading), but Scope is Machine, and elevation is never unknown.

cases.name: read-elevation-powershell-uninstall-machine
cases.note: The scope of a PowerShell Uninstall is unknown (§manager-powershell); elevation is read from Elevation and is never unknown.

cases.name: read-elevation-deny-elevated-not-applicable
cases.note: Control for read-elevation-deny-elevated.

cases.name: read-scope-default-user
cases.note: Default reading: Scope, and User when it is absent. The observer has one Allow rule per value and a catch-all; a known property also matches its value rule, while an unknown one matches none (§applicability), so only the catch-all applies to it.

cases.name: read-scope-default-machine-field

cases.name: read-scope-unknown-matches-deny
cases.note: Winget's scope is unknown when neither Scope nor --scope sets it (§manager-winget); an unknown property matches a Deny rule's selection. Control: read-scope-known-user-not-denied.

cases.name: read-scope-known-user-not-denied
cases.note: The same Deny rule against a known User scope.

cases.name: read-architecture-unknown-matches-deny

cases.name: read-scope-machine-default-nonelevated-install
cases.note: Chocolatey's scope is Machine when Scope is absent (§manager-chocolatey), and Elevation is NonElevated, so the request is unreadable whatever its operation. Control: read-chocolatey-plain, which is Elevated.

cases.name: read-scope-machine-default-elevated-update

cases.name: read-scope-machine-default-nonelevated-uninstall

cases.name: read-scope-unknown-pip-uninstall-nonelevated
cases.note: The scope of a Pip Uninstall is unknown without a custom parameter (§manager-pip), which keeps a NonElevated request readable.
